sn4.14:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati Ekasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme || ||
sn4.14:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti || || 2.
sn4.14:2.1: Atha kho Mārassa pāpimato etad ahosi || ||
sn4.14:2.2: Ayaṃ kho samaṇo Gotamo mahatiyā gihiparisāya parivuto dhammaṃ deseti ||
sn4.14:2.3: Yam nūnāhaṃ yena samaṇo Gotamo ten-upasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā ti || || 3.
sn4.14:2.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.14:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || pe || tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
